coverage.evidence: Create steps, dialog fields and validation order match dashboard/src/views/dashboard/timers/components/NewTimerDialog.vue:62-116 and timers/i18n/en.json:108-110,84. Default 30 minutes and limits 1-1440 and 0-10000 match timerDraft.ts:37-46 and server/src/NomNomzBot.Application/Commands/Dtos/TimerDtos.cs:68-74. The first post one interval after go-live matches TimerService.cs:219-225. Later posts are held by interval and Chat lines needed (TimerService.cs:166-186). Stopping through Enabled, Post once and Delete matches TimerEditor.vue:191-196, TimerService.cs:206-208 and TimersView.vue:46-49.

Create steps, the 500-character reply and the empty-field messages match NewChatTriggerDialog.vue:49,55,74,102. Defaults contains, case off, 30 s and Everyone match server/src/NomNomzBot.Application/Commands/Dtos/ChatTriggerDtos.cs:46-77 and Domain/Commands/Entities/ChatTrigger.cs. The four match modes and case handling match ChatMessageHandler.cs:1589-1615 and Platform/ChannelRegistry.cs:385-390. Cooldown clamped to 0-86400 matches ChatTriggerService.cs:28,111,179-182. The channel-wide cooldown with broadcaster and moderator exemption matches ChatMessageHandler.cs:1405-1413,1949-1950.

Page says a new timer is switched on (TimerDtos.cs:74) and starts with Chat lines needed 0 (timerDraft.ts:40, TimerDtos.cs:72). Page says it runs only while live and first posts one interval after go-live, then within about 30 s. This matches the current source: TimerService.cs:110-114 and 162-164 skip offline channels, 219-225 count from go-live, and 50 sets the 30 s tick. The card wording 'immediately due' and 'can run offline while the bot is connected' is contradicted by that source, so the page correctly follows the product rather than the stale card.

A failed simple-reply delivery returns false without stamping LastFiredAt, so the same line retries at the next check (TimerService.cs:198-199,315-324). A command, action or pipeline run that is skipped or fails still counts as a post (TimerService.cs:232-255,382-401,430). Post once switches the timer off only after a counted fire (TimerService.cs:203-209). TTS runs only after chat delivery (TimerService.cs:326).

Muted and shadowbanned viewers are ignored (ChatMessageHandler.cs:159-185). A prefixed or command-resolved line never reaches triggers (ChatMessageHandler.cs:194-204). A poll vote returns first (211-222), and an exact soundboard word claims the line even when refused or cooling (224-235). Triggers run last (249-252). The first match wins, a role miss continues to the next trigger, and a cooling match returns without falling through (1398-1430).

The Enabled switch calls toggle at once (TimerEditor.vue:191-196; ChatTriggerEditor.vue:75-76,97). Other fields are a draft saved by Save changes or reset by Discard (TimerEditor.vue:117-134,165-172,293-307). Duplicate copies the saved timer.data, names it '{name} copy', saves it with isEnabled false and opens it (TimerEditor.vue:137-163; i18n/en.json:98; TimersView.vue:127).

reader_answers.evidence: The timer path matches the route label Triggers and timers (dashboard/src/i18n/locales/en.json:840), the tabs in TimersView.vue:59-84, the dialog in NewTimerDialog.vue:278-330 and the 30-minute default in timerDraft.ts:37. The trigger path matches NewChatTriggerDialog.vue:79-107.

timers:write and chattriggers:write default to Moderator and above with no floor (ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:189,195). The reads default to Moderator with a VIP floor (188,194), and roles:manage is Broadcaster only (213).

The dialog closes on success (NewTimerDialog.vue:116; NewChatTriggerDialog.vue:74), and the new row is enabled by default (TimerDtos.cs:74; ChatTriggerDtos.cs:50). Red reasons come from the FormDialog error prop. A timer is time and activity gated (TimerService.cs:166-186), while a trigger matches non-command lines (ChatMessageHandler.cs:204-252).

Offline channels are skipped (TimerService.cs:110-114,162-164). The first post comes one interval after WentLiveAt (219-225). With 0 lines needed there is no activity gate (170), and the tick is 30 s (50). The timer stays enabled and saved after the stream, because only FireOnce disables it (206-208).
